title: Service reliability engineering and maintenance policy
workflow: Classify services by financial and regulatory criticality
Establish accountable ownership, alerts and dependency call tree
Specify safe read-only and fail-closed degraded modes
Define maintenance approval and customer-channel notifications
Measure actual error rates and recovery indicators
Review service failures with recorded root cause and remediation
invariants: Banking traffic cannot silently switch from posting to speculative buffered money changes
Fail-open behavior for money-moving authorization is prohibited
Read-only status must be visible and consistent with source cursor
Maintenance events preserve durable idempotency and audit trail
No unapproved automatic rail resubmission on outage recovery
SLO violation is recorded as evidence rather than hidden by averages
Independent finance review controls reopening after ledger divergence
acceptance_tests: Loss of account database makes posting fail closed
Read-only degraded mode displays accurate freshness
independent_gate: Approved error-budget and recovery policy, operational runbooks and executed chaos or maintenance simulations.
